device.description: 16-bit 100 kSPS sampling ADC with internal reference and serial output
device.note: ads7809.pdf (SBAS017C) p.3 specifications (input ranges, VIH), p.4 data format, data clock, VDIG 4.75-5.25 V, p.5 pin assignments, pin configuration, Table I and Figure 1, p.6 Table II timing and Figure 2, p.7 Table III control truth table and Table IV output codes, p.8 Figure 3a external-clock read after conversion, p.9 Figure 3b

pages: p.3 (input ranges, VIH 2.0 V to VD+0.3 V), p.4 (serial 16 bits, BTC or SB, internal/external data clock, VDIG 4.75-5.25 V), p.5 (pin assignments and configuration, Table I), p.6 (Table II: t3 BUSY low 8 us max, t6 conversion 8 us max, t18 data valid delay 55 ns max), p.7 (Table III, Table IV: BTC 0 V = 0000h, SB 0 V = 8000h on bipolar ranges), p.8 (Figure 3a: CS falling with R/C high, SYNC after DATACLK rising 1, MSB after rising 2)
notModeled: analog inputs, input-range resistor network (R1IN/R2IN/R3IN wiring, six ranges), internal reference (REF output) and CAP buffer

codeFormat assumes the bipolar ranges (+/-10 V first in Table I): SB/BTC high gives offset binary (0 V = 8000h), low two's complement (0000h). On the unipolar ranges 0 V is -full scale, which the model does not give

only the external data clock mode (EXT/INT high) is modeled, as SPI mode 1 framed by CS falling with R/C high: DATA changes after each DATACLK rising edge, the MSB after the second one (the first bit, before the MSB, is not specified: modeled 0). The internal-clock mode (EXT/INT low: the part drives 16 DATACLK pulses after each convert command, data from conversion n-1) is not modeled; DATACLK is never driven

a read started by R/C rising with CS held low is not framed (only CS falling starts a transfer); CS falling with R/C low also starts a conversion in the datasheet (CS and R/C are OR'ed) - the model starts conversions on R/C falling only
SYNC pulse (one DATACLK period after the first rising edge) is not driven; TAG daisy-chain data after the LSB (the model outputs zeros, as with TAG tied low)
reading during a conversion gives the previous result (Figure 3b); the shift register update rule while CS is low and DATACLK high is not modeled
PWRD (conversions inhibited, results kept) is not read; convert pulse width, VDIG <= VANA, throughput limits
variants: ADS7809UB is the higher grade of the same part (not in the skeleton).
